metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 Active Directory Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must have the proper access control permissions.

criterion.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must have the proper access control permissions.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must have the proper access control permissions.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Analyze the Domain Controllers OU permissions and return details on any failures
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: Import-Module GroupPolicy; Import-Module ActiveDirectory; if (-not (Get-PSDrive -Name AD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-PSDrive -Name AD -PSProvider ActiveDirectory -Root "" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; $dn = ([ADSI]"").distinguishedName; $AdminGroupRegex = 'SYSTEM|Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|Builtin\\Administrators|Administrators|CREATOR OWNER|SELF|Key Admins|Enterprise Key Admins|Exchange Enterprise Servers|Exchange Servers|Exchange Windows Permissions|Exchange Trusted Subsystem'; $ModRightsRegex = 'Write|CreateChild|DeleteChild|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Delete'; $f = Get-Acl -Path "AD:OU=Domain Controllers,$dn" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Access | Where-Object { $_.AccessControlType -eq 'Allow' -and $_.IdentityReference -notmatch $AdminGroupRegex -and $_.ActiveDirectoryRights.ToString() -match $ModRightsRegex } | Select-Object @{Name='IdentityReference';Expression={$_.IdentityReference.ToString()}}, @{Name='ActiveDirectoryRights';Expression={$_.ActiveDirectoryRights.ToString()}} -Unique | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ GPO = 'Domain Controllers OU'; Status = 'FAIL'; Reason = "Unauthorized Trustee '$($_.IdentityReference)' holds '$($_.ActiveDirectoryRights)' modification rights." } }; if ($f) { $f | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096 } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ GPO = 'Domain Controllers OU'; Status = 'PASS'; Reason = 'Delegation securely restricted to authorized administrative groups on Domain Controllers OU.' } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096 }

independent-def:shellcommand_state.comment: No lines shall exist listed with status of 'FAIL'
